# mcp/tests/fixtures/l109_tool_answers/PROVENANCE.md

## Governing Overview

[Owning route overview](../../overview.md)

## Purpose

Own the production-versus-recorded provenance and supported regeneration policy of the L109 answer-table fixtures.

## Code Commentary

The four tools have ordinary and largest-case samples. The three operation-produced largest samples use named producers for twenty compact path rows, a delivered knowledge page and a memory comparison. The file reader producer checks every relative brief pointer and its missing freshness under the returned memory root before pinning its reply. Recorded samples retain their historical roots, builds and logs.

Sanitization replaces selected volatile scratch/date/detail values for production pins while preserving other produced bytes. Regeneration is a hermetic pytest operation with the dedicated opt-in variable; curation does not regenerate or rewrite accepted fixture output. The lifecycle/base metadata remains evidence provenance, not a new code commit or acceptance.

## Evidence




- The named producer rebuilds the largest file-reader fixture from cold task memory. It checks twenty compact rows with relative brief pointers and missing freshness, and verifies that files, tree identity and Git status are unchanged. [1]
